title: Durable Review 2026: Pricing, Features, and Honest Verdict
summary: Durable is the fastest AI website builder tested, but it falls short on customization, ecommerce, and backend depth. Here's why Blink is the more complete platform for serious builders.
body_markdown: Blink. It covers Durable's core gaps natively, a fully editable Visual Editor instead of a structure that locks after generation, a real backend that supports ecommerce instead of a basic CRM, and a built-in SEO fix instead of none at all, and it's a more complete platform overall: growth tooling, human support, and agentic AI features are all things Durable doesn't offer.
